summary: This informational document defines the role of the operators of IETF protocol parameter registries, which record values that protocols use, so those values mean the same thing everywhere. It describes what such operators do and how they relate to the IETF. It was replaced by RFC 8722.

eli5.summary: Protocols share lists of agreed numbers and names. This says what the people who keep those lists must do. It was later replaced by RFC 8722.

questions: what is a protocol parameter registry operator
role of iana in ietf registries
